question: What is the Sl unit of 'volume'?
solution:
The correct answer is __Cubic metre**(m³)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Volume__ is a measure of the amount of space occupied by a substance or object.
 
• The SI unit of volume is the cubic metre (m³).
 
• 1 cubic metre (m³) is equivalent to 1000 litres.
 
• Other commonly used units of volume include litres, millilitres, and cubic centimetres, but these are not SI units.
 
• The cubic metre is used in applications such as measuring the volume of liquids, gases, or solid materials.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Conversion of Common Units:**

 
 
• 1 cubic metre (m³) = 1000 litres (L).
 
• 1 litre (L) = 1000 millilitres (mL).
 
• 1 cubic centimetre (cm³) = 1 millilitre (mL).
 
 
 
• **Practical Examples of Volume Measurement:**
 
 
• Measuring water or other liquids in containers.
 
• Calculating the capacity of a storage tank or reservoir.
 
• Determining the volume of a gas in industrial applications.
